clips.title: The story
paras: Near Deathknell, Samuel's Remains are gathered from a Scourge thrall and laid beside Marla.

Samuel Fipps and his wife Marla lived peacefully in Tirisfal Glades before the plague of undeath swept across Lordaeron. Samuel succumbed to the contagion and became the Scourge's mindless servant. Marla escaped undeath, but Samuel struck her down. With her dying breath, she asked to be buried beside him once his cursed form was put to rest. Novice Elreth in Deathknell sends newly awoken Forsaken northeast of the settlement to find Samuel's wandering form, recover his bones, and bury them in the front row of the local cemetery.
